Torque on a current loop in a magnetic field: τ = μ × B

Animation of the torque on a current loop. A square current loop centred on the origin in a uniform magnetic field B along z, drawn with y vertical and x receding into the page. Four arrows on the wire show the counter-clockwise current. At the centre of each edge a blue arrow shows B and a red arrow the magnetic force on that edge: vertical and opposite on the top and bottom edges, along x and opposite on the side edges. The magnetic moment mu (purple) makes an angle theta with z, and the torque mu cross B (green) points along x. The loop turns until theta is zero, the top and bottom forces lie on the y axis, and the torque vanishes.
